| Status | `403 Forbidden` |
| Type | `https://messagecrate.app/docs/developer/reference/errors/account-disabled` |

The account exists but the administrator has disabled it, so an API token it already has may not act. Disabling the account also ended its Session, so a Session token it held answers `authentication-required`. A login to a disabled account answers `invalid-credentials` instead, so a refused login does not tell a guesser that the password was right. Ask the administrator to enable it.
